title: Scripture and the Church
definition: Scripture and the Church belong together because the Church is gathered, governed, corrected, and sent under the authority of God's Word.
summary: The Church must be shaped by Scripture rather than preference, personality, or culture.
christFocus: Christ rules His Church by His Word and shepherds His people through the truth He has given.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Church is not free to invent its identity or mission. It belongs to Christ and must be ordered by His Word.

Scripture shapes preaching, teaching, worship, ordinances, leadership, discipline, fellowship, mission, and care. A healthy church receives the Word gladly and submits to it humbly.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Churches can drift when they are governed by preference, tradition, personality, or cultural pressure. Scripture and the Church matters because Christ's people must remain under Christ's Word.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Evaluate church life by Scripture. Support preaching, teaching, worship, and ministry that are faithful to the Word and centered on Christ.
